law.catch_line: Costs and attorney fee in suit on card; evidence of request or consent

text.section: In any suit arising out of the use of a credit card, where the request, consent, or use as required by § 6.2-425 is denied and is not proved, and judgment shall be for the defendant, the court shall assess against the issuer all court costs and shall award the defendant a reasonable attorney fee.
For purposes of subsection A, a certified copy of the request or consent shall be admissible as evidence that such request or consent was obtained.
